Rule Change

Due to some miscommunication on my part, I have made some clarifying corrections to the rules here, specifically the fourth:

Before:

Posts should state a stance or start the discussion in some way.

  • State your opinion, share some background information, etc.

After:

Posts should state a stance or start the discussion in some way.

  • State your opinion, share some background information, etc.
  • Links should only be posted in the body of a post, along with an opinion statement or other contributing information. Link posts by themselves are not allowed.

Link-posts are not and have not been allowed on /v/SeriousDiscussion. The reason for this is the focus I put on opinions and discussions rather than a catch-all repository for external articles, videos, and such. I want to avoid a change of focus from user-based discussions to article-based discussions because I made this sub to discuss and change opinions of different people here.

You can post links in your self-text posts, but it should be supporting/supported by an opinion statement or a direction of discussion.

Please feel free to use this post to discuss the changes here.

Moderation

Unfortunately, I am still on hiatus and cannot be on Voat that often. I can only speak for myself, but moderation here has been sporadic at best because of it.

If you want to help out and join the mod team here on SD, please contact me.
